objective.title: Understanding the Objective
description: The game is really simple. The cards are split evenly between all players. Every player must place a card every single round. The highest scoring card wins and takes all cards
The highest scoring card is an Ace and the lowest card is a two. The player who ends up with all cards wins.

war.title: War
description: A war is started if two or more players play the same highest card. All players must then place four cards, with the last card used to determine the winner of the war.
The Romanian Război variant forces you to place cards equal to the rank of the card that started the war (e.g. a King would be 13 cards).
